Documentation.UserDocu: The 3D sketch's view provider. In its edit, the manipulator and the input the mouse goes through, in view coordinates (Coin's: origin bottom left).
getManipulator() -> dict: Origin, Rotation, Plane ('XY', 'YZ', 'ZX'), HeightLock, HeightBase, RotationHandles, WorkingPlane (a Placement in the sketch's frame). None outside an edit.
toggleHeightLock(): keep the in-plane position under the pointer, move along the plane's normal
resetManipulator(): the sketch frame's orientation, plane XY
pointAt(x, y) -> Vector or None: where a click there lands, in the sketch's frame
toView(point: Vector) -> (x, y) or None: a point of the sketch's frame in view coordinates
press(x, y) -> bool: a left press there, as the mouse gives it; whether the edit took it
move(x, y) -> bool: the pointer moved there
pressRight(x, y) -> bool: a right press there: finishes the tool's placing
startTool(name): 'Point', 'Line', 'Polyline', 'BSplineThrough', 'BSplineControl' -- what the Sketcher's creation commands start in a 3D sketch's edit
activeTool() -> str: the tool's name, or 'None'
finishTool(): what Escape does: makes what is placed, or ends the tool
cancelTool(): ends the tool, dropping points not yet made
placedCount() -> int: points placed and not yet made into geometry
setConstructionMode(bool): the tools make construction geometry
